subject: Request: Bridge Program — combined credit + discount exception
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Bridge Program — combined credit + discount exception

Hi team,

Quick one — PolyBridge (prospect) asked for a combined onboarding sweetener to commit to a 12‑month reserved capacity pilot. They’re an important channel target for our partner motion in Q2 and have a real migration window (start of June). Current ask from procurement: 3 months free trial extension + $60,000 in credits + a 20% list discount on first year.

Why this matters:
- Potential ARR: ~$420k ARR if they convert post‑pilot (conservative model).
- They operate across healthcare verticals in NA and would be a reference for our Dedicated product.
- Decision timeline: they need approval before Friday EOD to start procurement.

What I need from you (can we approve as an exception?):
- Combined package (credits + discount) or an alternative counter-offer.
- Any limits from finance/legal on credits layering?

Attachments: PolyBridge_MAAPQ.pdf (procurement questionnaire), quote_PB-2028-042.xlsx (initial pricing).

Appreciate a quick read — happy to jump on a 15m if helpful.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415‑555‑0123

---
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Bridge Program — combined credit + discount exception

Tessa — thanks for the context. Can you add a short note on net revenue impact and churn risk? Two quick questions:
1) Is the $60k credit being used as free tokens (hosted) or as onboarding services/credits?
2) Do they need the discount applied to year 1 only or to the committed capacity line item?

I’ll prioritize this for the Friday deadline but need the impact numbers to move faster. If you can get procurement to confirm the conversion commitment language, that helps.

— Sofia
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Bridge Program — combined credit + discount exception

Folks — I ran a quick impact model and attached a spreadsheet (financial_impact_PB_analysis.csv). Key points:
- If we grant the full ask ($60k credits + 20% off year 1) and PolyBridge converts at the conservative rate Tessa mentioned, the NPV hit over 24 months is ~ $28k (credits + discounted revenue).
- I recommend a middle path: approve $50k in usage credits (hosted) convertible to billing credit upon go‑live and a one‑time 18% discount on year 1 committed capacity. That preserves signal while keeping our economics acceptable.
- If we need to tighten further, make credits contingent on a signed commitment (SOW + minimum MRR).

Suggested next steps:
- Tessa: get procurement to sign the commitment window in the SOW (I can draft a short clause).
- Legal: prepare an amendment for approval.
- Finance: confirm an accounting treatment note if credits are applied up front.

I’m OK to approve the middle path pending legal/finance confirmation.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: financial_impact_PB_analysis.csv

---
From: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@polybridge.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, procurement@polybridge.io
Date: 2028-03-23T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridge Program — procurement questions and timeline

Hi Tessa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement here — we can work with an amended SOW. Friday EOD is our funding cutoff for this sprint, so we’d need something binding before then. A couple clarifications:
- The $60k credit would be applied to usage across the pilot; we do not need services credits.
- Discount needs to apply to the committed capacity SKU for year 1 only.
- We can sign a conversion commitment (minimum 6 months of committed capacity at the end of pilot) if concrete incentives are approved.

If you can send the amended terms today we’ll prioritize signoff.

Thanks,
Elena Moreno
Director of Procurement, PolyBridge

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-24T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: PolyBridge exception (limited)

Team — after reviewing Marissa's analysis and confirming with finance/legal, I approve a limited exception for PolyBridge:
- Usage credits: $50,000 (hosted usage credits applied across the pilot)
- One‑time discount: 18% off the committed capacity SKU for year 1 only
- Trial extension: 90 days (pilot start window must be within 8 weeks of signature)

Conditions:
- Credits are redeemable only while in pilot and will be forfeited if contract is terminated before the committed conversion window.
- Procurement must sign the amended SOW with a minimum 6‑month committed capacity clause to trigger discount application.
- Legal to draft amendment; SalesOps will issue the updated commercial quote.

Tessa — please confirm you have procurement buy‑in and route the DocuSign once legal prepares the amendment. I’ll loop in finance privately for accounting notes.

Ben Carter
Chief Revenue Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: quote_PB-2028-042.xlsx (updated to reflect approval), DocuSign link to follow.
